newsitem.title: USA: Clearnet stake raised by Quebec agency.
newsitem.headline: Clearnet stake raised by Quebec agency.

text.p: Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec, which manages funds deposited by Quebec's agencies, said Monday it raised its stake in Clearnet Communications Inc to 1,874,473 Class A shares or 8.71 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the agency said its latest transactions include the purchase of 243,300 shares between March 24 and April 22 at prices ranging from C$10.30 to C$13.61 per share.
The agency said it holds the stake in the Pickering, ON, operation specializing in mobile radio wireless communication networks in Canada for investment purposes.
